description.text: I. Core Positioning of the DisciplineChemistry focuses on the essence and transformation of substances as its core research object. Through the combination of experiments and theory, it reveals the existence forms (such as molecules, atoms, ions) of substances, their internal structures (such as chemical bonds, crystal structures), physical and chemical properties (such as melting point, reactivity), as well as the change patterns that occur under certain conditions (such as decomposition, synthesis, and transformation). It is not only the foundation for understanding nature but also a key tool for creating new substances and solving problems related to energy, environment, and health faced by humanity.II. Training ObjectivesTo cultivate high-quality talents with solid chemical knowledge, experimental skills, and scientific thinking, who can engage in scientific research, teaching, technology development, product testing, management, etc. in the field of chemistry and related areas. Core competencies include: Master the core theories of inorganic chemistry, organic chemistry, analytical chemistry, and physical chemistry;Proficiently use various chemical experimental instruments (such as spectrometers, chromatographs, mass spectrometers), and possess the ability to design and operate experiments, as well as analyze data;Understand the latest developments in the field of chemistry, have preliminary scientific research and innovation capabilities, and be able to apply chemical principles to solve practical problems.

duration.text: The Chemical at Shaanxi University of Science and Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Fill in personal information and upload attachments required by specific programme on the website https://sust.at0086.cn/student2.Copy of original passport photopage and previous Chinese Visa pages.3.Notarized highest diploma and thenotarized Chinese/English translation (Prospective diploma recipients must submit official document issued by your current school to prove your current student status or expected graduation date).4.Original academic transcripts and the notarized Chinese/English translation.5.Non-criminal Record and the notarized Chinese translation.6.Foreigner Physical Examination Form (in English and valid within 6 months）7.The copy of valid HSK or IELTS/TOEFL Certificate.8.Resumein Chinese or English.9.A Study Plan in Chinese or English.10.Two recommendation letters in Chinese or English by associate professors or scholars with the same titles and above for Master and Doctoral program.11.Related research Proposals, papers, portfolios and awards.12.Self-introduction short video

requirements.text: Non-Chinese citizens who are in good health and have excellent academic performance. For those who were originally Chinese citizens but later acquired foreign citizenship, our school follows the "Notice of the Ministry of Education on Regulating the Work of Accepting International Students by Higher Education Institutions" at http://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-06/10/content_5518369.htm.Those applying for long-term language training without a degree must have a high school diploma or above, and their age should generally not exceed 25 years old.Those pursuing a master's degree must have a bachelor's degree or above, and their age should generally not exceed 30 years old. Those pursuing a doctoral degree must have a master's degree or above, and their age should generally not exceed 35 years old.Those applying for courses taught entirely in English must have an English proficiency score of 6.0 or above on the IELTS or 80 or above on the TOEFL.Those with a bachelor's degree from a Chinese university must have a Chinese proficiency level of HSK 4 and a score of 200 or above.
